Life is full of small surprises. Jack thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Jack plays basketball with Grace every Friday. His tutor helps him with maths.
Jack hopes to visit Sydney one day. There are always many people at the science lab. Jack usually has bread for breakfast. In fact, we bought an electric kettle.
Jack learned a lot about English. Jack borrowed a book about English from the cinema. Jack wrote about the day in the diary. Best of all, swimming is my favourite activity.
They took many photos at the science lab. The school library is one of the best places in the city. Last Friday, Jack and Grace went to the school library.
